definitions.gloss: youthful; looking young; full of youthful energy
definitions.explanation: Appearing or feeling young, especially for one's age. A compliment suggesting vitality, freshness, and energy.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はいつも{若々|わかわか}しい。
{若々|わかわか}しい{肌|はだ}を{保|たも}つ。
60{歳|さい}を{過|す}ぎても{若々|わかわか}しくて、とても{年齢|ねんれい}には{見|み}えない。
examples.english: Even past 60, they look so youthful that you'd never guess their age.

notes: Formed by doubling {若|わか}い (young) with the suffix しい, creating an emphatic, vivid adjective. Used as a compliment, especially for older people who look or act younger than their age. Common collocations: {若々|わかわか}しい{姿|すがた} (youthful appearance), {若々|わかわか}しい{声|こえ} (youthful voice). Unlike {若|わか}い, which simply states that someone is young, {若々|わかわか}しい emphasizes the impression of youthfulness.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {若々|わかわか}しくなかったら
